text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"What sheer humiliation,
to lose in a place like this!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"How frustrating...! It's infuriating...!
At this rate, unifying the realm is still far out of reach!"
choice_data_list: Let's learn from this mistake next time.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: "Even the great Tokugawa Ieyasu lost battles, after all. He used his defeats as a lesson to admonish himself—"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Indeed! When it comes to admonishing oneself after a defeat, nothing beats Tokugawa Ieyasu's Portrait of the Battle of Mikatagahara!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
So that I never forget this frustration,
paint a portrait capturing my remorseful face in defeat!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ...What's this, a smartphone camera? Very well, make sure you capture this face properly!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that we've left that frustration behind,
all that's left is to win next time!
choice_data_list: Next time, I'll leave a photo full of smiles!
Next time, I'll leave a photo full of smiles!
No, let's use the photo as a reminder and train harder!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit, Trainer!
Next time, we'll cross that finish line with a smile!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: And I'll make sure to bring a smile to your face too!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
As expected of my Tactician!
You truly keep your feet firmly on the ground!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I'm expecting a training menu
fit for conquering the top!
